text: Members of Council may file petitions.

City Council on November 13 and 14, 2024, received the following petitions for information: 1. Petition headed "As faith leaders, community members and proud Canadians, we are united in our commitment to uphold Canada as a place of respect, safety, and unity for all. Deeply concerned by the rising tide of antisemitism and division, we pledge to protect the values that make this country a beacon of peace and strength" by Councillor Brad Bradford, Ward 19 - Beaches-East York, containing the signatures of approximately 49 persons. 2. Petition headed "Conversion of Line 3 Guideway to Busway - Mooregate Avenue/Tara Avenue bus stop" by Councillor Michael Thompson, Ward 21 - Scarborough Centre, containing the signatures of approximately 180 persons.
